description: Free, company only. Sets the https URL that receives signed events about your agents: credential issued, renewed, suspended, reinstated, revoked. Request signed with your e-CNPJ; url "-" removes it.

ecnpj_signature.description: CMS/PKCS#7 SignedData of signed_text with the company's e-CNPJ, detached, base64 DER.

signed_text.description: "KYA Brasil: <agents|webhook> <cnpj>", for the webhook a "url: <https url or ->" line, then "at: <ISO time>" (within 10 minutes).

name: kya_company_webhook
